name: Ha Long squid cake
summary: Chả mực Hạ Long is the squid cake on the cruise boats, at provincial banquets, and on the Tết table. Cổng thông tin Quảng Ninh says the cake is mực mai from Hạ Long or Vân Đồn, cleaned, hand-pounded, shaped, and fried. Eat it hot, with bánh cuốn, xôi trắng, or cơm.
origin: Hạ Long, Quảng Ninh. The tourism pages treat it as a Quảng Ninh dish and a Hạ Long specialty.
culture: Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh calls it one of 50 specialties recognized by Trung tâm Sách kỷ lục Việt Nam. It is served on the cruise boats and at provincial banquets.

The same office’s Tết article calls it a dish of Quảng Ninh cooking and a gift. In 2024, over the 30 April–1 May holiday at Công viên Đại Dương in phường Bãi Cháy, visitors were served chả mực and beer free and looked at a record squid cake. That free service is the 2024 festival. Do not extend it to another year.

Cổng thông tin Quảng Ninh quotes a long-time seafood trader who says nobody remembers when the cake began, and that people in Hạ Long were already buying squid, pounding it by hand, and frying it in the early years of the 20th century. The same article says the gift cake is cooled and vacuum-packed.
howToEat: Eat it hot, with bánh cuốn, xôi trắng, or cơm. Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh prints that line.
VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, says people in Hạ Long eat bánh cuốn with this cake rather than with chả quế or chả thịt. The roll is its own plate.
A breakfast clock for the cake alone was not printed. On the boat, or at Tết on the family table, is when Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh places it. Check on arrival.
where: On the cruise boats, and at the Hạ Long table. Xôi chả mực is the rice and the cake together.
Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, says chợ Hạ Long 1 on đường Bạch Đằng and chợ Hạ Long 2 on đường Lê Lợi sell fresh chả mực, pounded at the shops, to take home.
seoTitle: Cha muc Ha Long — squid cake with rice or rice sheets
seoDescription: Chả mực Hạ Long is mực mai, hand-pounded and fried, eaten hot with bánh cuốn, xôi trắng, or cơm. A current stall price is Check on arrival.
texture: VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, and Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, call the fried cake golden and fragrant, crisp at the edge and chewy inside. The squid is ground or hand-pounded so that chew stays.
